issue: When the dashboard LAN card was opened with no saved profiles, refreshing LAN settings called ProfileRepository.activeProfile(), which throws when the profile table is empty. The ViewModel surfaced a settings error and disabled the switch.

fix.behavior: Resolve the active profile through nullable activeProfileId()/profileById() lookups. With no profile, read or persist the user's LAN preference and publish an empty-port state without loading or starting Mihomo. The configured-profile path keeps its existing core readback and hot-update behavior.

limits: This regression covers the empty-profile dashboard save path; this batch did not repeat active-profile core hot-update or real LAN client traffic tests.
IPv6-only networking and Wi-Fi/cellular transitions were not part of this switch regression.
